name: Birthday Present
game_text: <phase>Fellowship</phase>: Add a burden to choose 2 <culture>Shire</culture> events with different card titles from your discard pile. Choose an opponent and make him or her choose 1 of those cards for you to take into hand.
flavor_text: “‘...he caught Déagol by the throat and strangled him, because the gold looked so bright and beautiful.’”
